content.test_md_blob:
# Use keyboard navigation to switch dashboard context in place

> Prove the sidebar can be operated by keyboard so a focused navigation item becomes active and updates the workspace heading without leaving the current page.

## Step 1

Open ORBITAL at {{start_url}} in a fresh browser session.

## Step 2

Store the current browser URL as baseline_url, the current workspace heading as baseline_heading, and the active sidebar item as baseline_active.

## Step 3

Using keyboard navigation only in the left sidebar, move focus to the Risk item in the ANALYTICS section and confirm the focused item shows a visible focus indicator.

## Step 4

Activate the focused Risk item from the keyboard; store the resulting workspace heading as updated_heading and the resulting active sidebar item as updated_active.

## Step 5

Assert the current browser URL still equals baseline_url, updated_active is Risk and differs from baseline_active, and updated_heading differs from baseline_heading.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-10, ac-1, ac-7, ac-8

Confirm presence check: a visible focus indicator on the currently focused sidebar navigation item (exists) — the stated promise: A focused sidebar navigation item shows visible focus during keyboard navigation.
